name: IGTAP: an Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find IGTAP: an Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer on Steam now!


Cookie clicker meets Celeste: Complete short platforming sections for currency, then spend it on upgrading your income, buying clones that copy your best path, or improving your movement.

NOTE: It may appear as a grey screen upon initial load. Please let it sit for a few seconds, the game WILL load!
